name: Cataño (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Nine horizontal stripes of blue and white, after the municipal arms, crossed by a white and green diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, the green for the palm trees of the arms.
history: Cataño is a town and municipality on the northeastern coastal plain of Puerto Rico, across the bay from San Juan. The flag reproduces the colours and stripes of the municipal shield, with a green and white diagonal for its palm trees; it was officially adopted on 5 September 1974 under Mayor José Alvarez Brunet.

features.role: diagonal band of white and green
